answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim to unify MLS and CLS into a more general setting named many-to-many summarization (M2MS).

answer_2.quote: Metrics. We adopt ROUGE-1/2/L and BERTSCORE in our experiments.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. Following ; , we conduct the human evaluation on 50 random samples extracted from WikiLingua (En⇒Zh, Zh⇒En and En⇒En, respectively). Three graduate students are invited to assess the generated summaries from three aspects: informativeness (IF), conciseness (CC) and grammaticality (GM).
answer_4.guideline: assess the generated summaries from three aspects: informativeness, conciseness and grammaticality using a 5-point scale
